raw_segments.text: On the Monday morning, at a quarter before nine, Herbert went to the Counting House to
report himself, to look about him, too, I suppose, and I bore him company. He was to
come away in an hour or two to attend me to Hammersmith, and I was to wait about for him.
It appeared to me that the eggs from which young insurers were hatched were incubated
in dust and heat, like the eggs of ostriches, judging from the places to which those incipient
giants repaired on a Monday morning.
Nor did the Counting House, where Herbert assisted, show in my eyes as at all a good
observatory, being a back second floor up a yard, of a grimy presence in all particulars,
and with a look into another back second floor, rather than a lookout.
